pairs.note: The trigger clause matches the key exactly (Orla Penhallow; death, permanent incapacity, ceasing to serve as CIO, or failing to devote substantially all business time for more than 120 consecutive days). However, the answer omits the consequences that the key requires: that Limited Partners may redeem as of the first Redemption Date after the event without regard to lock-up, early redemption charge, notice period or the Investor-Level Gate, and that new subscriptions are suspended until a successor CIO is designated. Missing required elements.
